limitations: HWUI histogram covers full reported capture; raw timestamps are a recent CSV ring, frequently <=120 samples, with P99 sometimes equal to maximum. CPU/PSS are sampled on a SwiftShader emulator. Phase timestamps overlap; render completion is not isolated GPU work. No genuine >=5s completed frame discarded. A previous independent fixed-world run had worse candidate pinch P99 and remains recorded; these replications do not prove universal tail improvement.
